description: Sen. Susan Collins (R) announced that two emergency medical services (EMS) departments in Maine would receive a combined $600,000. The grants are provided through the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration’s (SAMHSA) Supporting and Improving Rural EMS Needs (SIREN) program. Brooks Ambulance Service received $300,000 to improve EMS training for Advanced Emergency Medical Technicians […]
